population_rule: Preparation uses only deterministic synthetic fixtures representing the contract failures observed on 2026-08-02. No race result, payout, popularity, final odds, or candidate replacement is available to the implementation.
chronology_rule: The candidate batch must be committed before the earliest candidate cutoff. A schedule-only observation must be locked before any odds request, and the odds request must satisfy schedule_poll_open <= request < strict_t3_cutoff using that locked schedule version.
domain_rule: Only explicitly allowlisted flat turf and dirt race domains may become CANDIDATE_READY. Obstacle or unknown race domains remain in the denominator as deterministic FAILED records with UNSUPPORTED_RACE_TYPE.
quote_rule: The existing strict 60-second quote-age and ingestion-delay limits are unchanged. No synthetic case may reinterpret a 90-second-old provider timestamp as strict T-3 eligible.

synthetic_cases.purpose: Prove a supported flat turf row can freeze when the source batch is committed before the earliest cutoff.
Prove a supported flat dirt row can freeze under the same batch-readiness contract.
Prove an obstacle row is retained but never passed to the frozen flat-race model.
Prove an unrecognized domain fails closed rather than becoming an all-zero categorical encoding.
Prove a late morning batch cannot silently create only the later-race candidates.
Prove a 15:01 post opens at 14:57:30 and not at a rounded clock minute.
Prove the schedule-only lock moves the poll open from 14:56:30 to 14:57:30 without latching the early quote.
Prove an update that cannot be applied prospectively fails closed.
Prove the current strict 60-second freshness contract remains unchanged.
Prove a supported race can reach PAPER_READY only after domain, source, schedule, and quote contracts all pass.
